Security‑focused builders now have a concrete reference point for what a ‘Critical’ LLM can look like, potentially reducing the amount of custom hardening required when the model rolls out [FACT:430263a05fd173602cd07f14123edd7c].

The current public statement only provides the ‘Critical’ classification, leaving performance numbers and rollout timing undisclosed [FACT:430263a05fd173602cd07f14123edd7c].
